changes.original_model_translation: First confirm the locations of the target object and the desklamp; the desklamp is usually fixed on a furniture surface. If the desklamp has already been observed on a surface such as a desk, side table, or dresser, go directly to that furniture and do not continue searching unrelated containers or blindly opening drawers. If the target object is not at the desklamp, first obtain and carry the target object to that furniture; if the target object is already at the desklamp, directly try to use the desklamp, and if the interaction is not accepted, ensure the target object is in hand and retry. After arriving, use use desklamp <id> with the instance ID to trigger the observation; do not use bare names or compound syntax, and do not treat the desklamp as a carryable object or navigation point. Successfully turning on the desklamp is the termination condition; do not append use/look afterward.
